tagline: Your local STIHL shop for equipment, service and parts
heroSubheading: We stock leading brands and service what we sell
aboutHtml:
Grant Blanchet has been running STIHL SHOP Richmond since 2011, providing the community with quality outdoor power equipment and expert technical service. We stock STIHL, Masport, Honda, Walker, Hustler, and Wacker Neusson. We know the local landscape and what works best here.

We're here to get you the right equipment for your job and keep it running. We sell in-store and online, and we service what we sell. Come to us for advice, parts, repairs, and everything in between. Our goal is to get you sorted.

We're invested in Richmond. We sponsor Waimea Old Boys Rugby Club, Greenacres Golf, and Keep Richmond Beautiful because this is our town and we're part of the community. Come in and talk to us about what you need.
whatMakesUsSpecial: We fix equipment, not just sell it
Six quality brands to choose from
servicesIntro: Our team services and repairs equipment in our local Richmond workshop.
